title: Understanding Regularization
text: As the regularization parameter lambda increases, the model complexity is penalized more heavily. This affects the coefficients of the model. Think about what happens to the coefficients when lambda is very large.

title: Mean-Centered Data
text: When data is mean-centered, each feature has a mean of zero. Consider how this affects the intercept term and the predictions of the model.

title: Effect of Large Lambda
text: What happens to the coefficients of a linear model as lambda approaches $$\infty$$?

hintAnswer: the mean of the true $$y$$ values
title: Predictions with Mean-Centered Data
text: If the data is mean-centered, what do the predictions of the model approach as lambda becomes very large?
choices: the mean of the true $$y$$ values
